fluidloggable.config.title: Fluidloggable
fluidloggable.config.client_only_compati: Requires restart. Disables Fluidloggable mixins on physical clients so vanilla servers use the vanilla block state palette.
fluidloggable.config.collision_shape_flu: Uses a fluidloggable block's entity collision shape to decide whether water and lava can pass through. Controlled by the server in multiplayer.
fluidloggable.config.fluidloggable_mod_i: Requires restart. Makes every block from each listed mod a dynamic water and lava container. Enter namespace-only IDs such as displaydelight.
fluidloggable.config.fluidloggable_block: Requires restart. Makes only the listed blocks dynamic water and lava containers. Enter full identifiers such as minecraft:lantern.
